title: Without See Financial Data no dollar fields are shown
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. Logged in as a user WITHOUT see-financial-data permission; a saved selection that previously included dollar fields.
custom_steps:
1. Open List, Tech View, and Board View.
  2. Confirm no dollar-amount fields appear in the displays, in filters, or in the field/column pickers.
  3. Confirm a saved filter/field selection that included dollar values does not reveal them.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Without "see financial data" permission, all dollar-amount fields are hidden from displays, filters, and the field/column pickers.
  • Saved filters and field selections never reveal financial values when "see financial data" is off.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10048 — Story 5 Choose what is shown. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options (Draft Spec)”, Draft v0.9, requirement(s) S5-E2, S5-E6 (read 23 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 23 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S5-E2: “Without see financial data permission, hide all dollar-amount fields from displays, filters, and field/column pickers.”
  • S5-E6: “Saved filters and field selections must not reveal financial values when see financial data is off.”
